source: SDLC-3 R7a/R7b-B: two overlapping imports replaced the list without asking (accepted fix 4687e05)
prompt: Bug report: a customer picks a backup file to import and, while it is still being read, picks a second, smaller file. The small file fills the empty list. When the first file finishes reading, it replaces that list without showing the confirm dialog. Importing must never replace a non-empty list without asking first. Fix it.
